name: Derivative steel, aluminum, and copper articles subject to 25% Section 232 duty (Proclamation 11021)
notes: Proclamation 11021 (April 2, 2026, effective April 6, 2026) established a 25% rate on 'derivative articles substantially made of steel, aluminum, or copper' on full customs value.

These codes were previously included in the steel_products_03_05_2025.json and aluminum_products_03_05_2025.json files at 50% (under the pre-April 2026 structure). They have been reclassified to 25% per Proclamation 11021.

Note: Some of these codes may qualify for the 15% reduced rate if they meet the 'fixed industrial machinery, grid equipment' criteria per Proclamation 11021, or the agricultural/mobile industrial equipment criteria per Proclamation 11032 (FR 2026-11314, effective June 8, 2026). Verify against the full annexes to those proclamations.

Note: Per heading 9903.82.03 of Proclamation 11021 Annex IV, articles where the applicable metal weight is less than 15% (<15%, not ≤15%) of the total imported article weight are no longer subject to Section 232 additional duties. Exception: this exemption does NOT apply to articles classifiable in chapters 72, 73, 74, or 76 (primary steel, copper, and aluminum articles remain subject to S232 regardless of metal content). Articles in this list meeting the <15% threshold (and not in chapters 72–76) should be removed upon verification.
Auto and auto parts (Chapter 87 codes below) are also covered by autos_autoparts_04_03_2025.json at 25%. The effective rate is 25% from either authority; do not double-count.
